modification_reason: Renamed to erlang27 and pinned to the 27.x line since RabbitMQ (the only current consumer) doesn't support Erlang 28/29. Added %{?hummingbird} to the doc-build bcond guard (Hummingbird doesn't define %fedora/%rhel, so the upstream guard always fell through to needing ex_doc, unpackaged upstream too). Added unversioned erlang/erlang-* Provides aliases to every subpackage so consumers keep using plain BuildRequires/Requires: erlang(-*) without editing their specs.
